reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: accrue_interest has multiple non-test callers in market.move (lines 274, 459, 578, 647, 884, 901, 919); BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions field so Gate 2 cannot trigger; market.move is explicitly in scope. An attacker (any borrower) can trigger this by repaying any loan — repay_fee_rate is passed as reserve_factor to reserve.accrue_interest() instead of charging a repay fee, causing zero repay fees to be collected from borrowers and a misconfigured reserve factor that severely under-accumulates protocol treasury reserves needed for bad debt coverage. Severity calibrated to Medium: no direct user fund theft, but systematic protocol revenue loss and reduced bad-debt resilience.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: AssetConfig.repay_fee_rate — documented as 'fee rate paid to the protocol in repay'; market.move:1025 reserve.accrue_interest(asset.repay_fee_rate(), ...)
